NYMPH_THOUGHT_FTUE_BODY_1:
[gold]Thought[/gold] is this mod's special mechanic.
Whenever you play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Thought[/gold].
The upper UI number is [gold]Thought[/gold], and the lower numbers are the [gold]Confusion Threshold[/gold]/[gold]Obstruction Threshold[/gold].
NYMPH_THOUGHT_FTUE_BODY_2:
You begin [green]Clear[/green].
Upon reaching the Confusion/Obstruction Threshold, enter [orange]Confused[/orange]/[red]Obstructed[/red], respectively.
[green]Clear[/green]: Whenever you play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
[orange]Confused[/orange]: No special effect.
[red]Obstructed[/red]: Whenever you play a card, take [blue]1[/blue] damage.
NYMPH_THOUGHT_FTUE_BODY_3:
Card keywords:
[gold]Conceive[/gold] grants extra [gold]Thought[/gold].
[gold]Narrate[/gold] converts [gold]Thought[/gold] into [gold]Block[/gold] and triggers follow-up effects.
